{"version":"Notebook/1.0","items":[{"type":1,"content":{"json":"## ASD Essential Eight: Patch applications and Patch operating systems

This workbook measures vulnerability remediation timeframes, exploited vulnerabilities (including CISA KEV and vendor-confirmed exploits), and unsupported software or operating systems using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management tables (`DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities`, `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilitiesKB`, `DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory`, `DeviceInfo` and `IntuneDevices`).

**ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model (November 2023) timeframes:**
- **48 hours**: Critical or actively exploited vulnerabilities in online services, internet-facing OS, core user applications (browsers, Office, PDF, email clients, security software), and at ML3 all applications and operating systems.
- **2 weeks (14 days)**: Non-critical vulnerabilities in core applications (ML1 to ML3), internet-facing OS (ML2 to ML3), and all other applications and OS (ML3).
- **1 month (30 days)**: Non-critical vulnerabilities in other applications (ML2) and non-internet-facing workstation/server OS (ML1 to ML2).

> **Disclaimer:** Independent community workbook. Not produced, endorsed or supported by ASD, ACSC or Microsoft. {"version":"Notebook/1.0","items":[{"type":1,"content":{"json":"## ASD Essential Eight: Multi-factor authentication (MFA)

Monitors MFA coverage, phishing-resistant MFA adoption (FIDO2 security keys, Windows Hello for Business, certificate-based authentication), legacy authentication usage and Conditional Access policy exclusions across Microsoft Entra ID (`SigninLogs`, `AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs`, `AuditLogs`) and Microsoft Sentinel UEBA (`IdentityInfo`).

**ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model (November 2023) summary:**
- **ML1**: MFA enforced for online services and sensitive third-party services; legacy authentication blocked.
- **ML2**: Phishing-resistant MFA enforced for online services, sensitive data repositories and all privileged users; MFA events and Conditional Access changes centrally logged.
- **ML3**: Phishing-resistant MFA enforced for all users authenticating to workstations, servers, online services and data repositories with no unapproved exclusions.

properties.displayName: Essential Eight - Exploited or Critical Vulnerability Overdue Beyond 48 Hours
Essential Eight - Exploited or Critical Vulnerability Overdue Beyond 48 Hours
properties.description:
Detects critical or actively exploited vulnerabilities (including CISA KEV and vendor-flagged exploits)
on managed endpoints that remain unpatched beyond the 48-hour timeframe defined in the ASD Essential
Eight Maturity Model (November 2023) for Patch applications and Patch operating systems.
Reference: https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model
properties.query:
let kb = DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilitiesKB
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, PublishedDate, IsExploitAvailable, CvssScore) by CveId;
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform) by DeviceId, DeviceName;
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate, CveTags) by DeviceId, DeviceName, CveId
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| join kind=inner kb on CveId
| extend AgeHours = datetime_diff('hour', now(), PublishedDate)
| extend IsExploited = (IsExploitAvailable == true or tostring(CveTags) has_any ('ZeroDay', 'ExploitInTheWild', 'CISA_KEV'))
| where AgeHours > 48
| where IsExploited or (VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == 'Critical' and IsInternetFacing == true)
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, MachineGroup, IsInternetFacing, CveId, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, IsExploited, AgeHours, RecommendedSecurityUpdate

properties.displayName: Essential Eight - Unsupported Operating System Active in Environment
Essential Eight - Unsupported Operating System Active in Environment
properties.description:
Detects onboarded endpoints running operating systems that are no longer supported by their vendor.
The ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model (November 2023) requires unsupported operating systems to be
replaced at Maturity Level 1 and above (E8-POS-ML1-03).
Reference: https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model
properties.query:
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform, OSVersion, OSBuild, OSVersionInfo) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| where OSPlatform in~ ('Windows7', 'Windows8', 'Windows81', 'WindowsXP', 'WindowsVista', 'WindowsServer2008', 'WindowsServer2008R2', 'WindowsServer2012', 'WindowsServer2012R2')
    or (OSPlatform =~ 'Windows10' and toint(OSBuild) < 19045)
    or (OSPlatform =~ 'Windows11' and toint(OSBuild) < 22631)
    or OSVersionInfo has_any ('EndOfLife', 'Unsupported')
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, MachineGroup, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform, OSVersion, OSBuild, OSVersionInfo

properties.displayName: Essential Eight - Conditional Access Exclusion Added
Essential Eight - Conditional Access Exclusion Added
properties.description:
Detects modifications to Microsoft Entra ID Conditional Access policies where user, group, role
or application exclusions are added or expanded. Maps to ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model
requirements E8-MFA-ML2-03 and E8-MFA-ML3-01.
Reference: https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where Category == 'Policy'
| where OperationName in~ ('Update conditional access policy', 'Add conditional access policy')
| where Result =~ 'success'
| mv-expand Target = TargetResources
| mv-expand Prop = Target.modifiedProperties
| extend OldVal = tostring(Prop.oldValue), NewVal = tostring(Prop.newValue)
| where NewVal has_any ('excludeUsers', 'excludeGroups', 'excludeRoles', 'excludeApplications')
| where NewVal != OldVal
| extend ActorUPN = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend ActorIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| extend PolicyName = tostring(Target.displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, PolicyName, ActorUPN, ActorIP, OldVal, NewVal

properties.displayName: Essential Eight - Successful Legacy Authentication Sign-In
Essential Eight - Successful Legacy Authentication Sign-In
properties.description:
Detects successful Microsoft Entra ID sign-ins using legacy authentication protocols (IMAP4, POP3,
SMTP, Exchange ActiveSync, Exchange Web Services, Autodiscover, MAPI Over HTTP or Other clients)
that bypass modern multi-factor authentication. Maps to ASD Essential Eight requirement E8-MFA-ML1-03.
Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/block-legacy-authentication
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where ResultType == '0'
| where ClientAppUsed in~ (
    'IMAP4',
    'POP3',
    'SMTP',
    'Exchange ActiveSync',
    'Exchange Web Services',
    'Autodiscover',
    'MAPI Over HTTP',
    'Other clients'
)
| summarize SignInCount = count(), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ClientAppUsed
| project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ClientAppUsed, SignInCount, Apps

properties.displayName: Essential Eight - Privileged Account Sign-In Without Phishing-Resistant MFA
Essential Eight - Privileged Account Sign-In Without Phishing-Resistant MFA
properties.description:
Detects successful interactive sign-ins by accounts holding Microsoft Entra ID directory roles
that did not authenticate with a phishing-resistant MFA method (FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business
or certificate-based authentication). Maps to ASD Essential Eight requirements E8-MFA-ML2-02 and E8-MFA-ML3-01.
Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/concept-authentication-strengths
properties.query:
let privUsers = IdentityInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AssignedRoles) by AccountUPN
| where array_length(AssignedRoles) > 0
| project AccountUPN = tolower(AccountUPN), AssignedRoles;
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == '0'
| extend UserLower = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner privUsers on $left.UserLower == $right.AccountUPN
| extend AuthDetailsStr = tostring(AuthenticationDetails)
| extend IsPhishingResistant = AuthDetailsStr has_any ('FIDO2', 'Windows Hello for Business', 'Certificate-based authentication', 'Passkey')
| where IsPhishingResistant == false
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, AuthenticationRequirement, AssignedRoles = tostring(AssignedRoles), AuthDetailsStr

properties.displayName: Essential Eight - Conditional Access Policy Disabled, Weakened or Deleted
Essential Eight - Conditional Access Policy Disabled, Weakened or Deleted
properties.description:
Detects Microsoft Entra ID Conditional Access policies being deleted or switched to disabled or
report-only state, which can cause immediate regression in MFA enforcement. Maps to ASD Essential
Eight requirement E8-MFA-ML2-03.
Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/monitoring-health/concept-audit-logs
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where Category == 'Policy'
| where OperationName in~ ('Delete conditional access policy', 'Update conditional access policy')
| where Result =~ 'success'
| mv-expand Target = TargetResources
| extend PolicyName = tostring(Target.displayName)
| extend ModifiedProps = tostring(Target.modifiedProperties)
| where OperationName =~ 'Delete conditional access policy'
    or ModifiedProps has_any ('"state":"disabled"', '"state":"enabledForReportingButNotEnforced"')
| extend ActorUPN = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend ActorIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, PolicyName, ActorUPN, ActorIP, ModifiedProps

properties.displayName: Essential Eight - Privileged Account Used for Email or Web Productivity Services
Essential Eight - Privileged Account Used for Email or Web Productivity Services
properties.description:

Reference: https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model
properties.query:
let privUsers = IdentityInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AssignedRoles) by AccountUPN
| where array_length(AssignedRoles) > 0
| project AccountUPN = tolower(AccountUPN), AssignedRolesStr = tostring(AssignedRoles);
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == '0'
| extend UserLower = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner privUsers on $left.UserLower == $right.AccountUPN
| where AppDisplayName has_any (
    'Office 365 Exchange Online',
    'Outlook',
    'Microsoft Teams',
    'Office 365 SharePoint Online',
    'OneDrive',
    'Microsoft 365'
)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, AssignedRolesStr

properties.displayName: Essential Eight - Standing Global Administrator Assignment Outside PIM
Essential Eight - Standing Global Administrator Assignment Outside PIM
properties.description:
Detects permanent (standing) assignments to Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator
in Microsoft Entra ID outside time-bound Privileged Identity Management (PIM) activation.
Maps to ASD Essential Eight requirement E8-RAP-ML2-02.
Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-governance/privileged-identity-management/pim-configure
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where Category == 'RoleManagement'
| where OperationName in~ ('Add member to role', 'Add member to role outside of PIM (permanent)')
| where Result =~ 'success'
| where OperationName !has 'eligible' and OperationName !has 'PIM activation'
| mv-expand Target = TargetResources
| extend TargetProps = tostring(Target.modifiedProperties)
| where TargetProps has_any ('Global Administrator', 'Company Administrator', 'Privileged Role Administrator', 'Security Administrator')
| extend ActorUPN = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend ActorIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| extend TargetUPN = tostring(Target.userPrincipalName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, ActorUPN, ActorIP, TargetUPN, TargetProps

properties.displayName: Essential Eight - Entra PIM Activation Without Valid Justification
Essential Eight - Entra PIM Activation Without Valid Justification
properties.description:
Detects Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM) role activations where the recorded
justification is missing or trivially short (fewer than 5 characters). Maps to ASD Essential Eight
requirement E8-RAP-ML3-01.
Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-governance/privileged-identity-management/pim-how-to-use-audit-log
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where Category == 'RoleManagement'
| where OperationName has 'Add member to role completed (PIM activation)'
| where Result =~ 'success'
| extend Justification = tostring(AdditionalDetails[0].value)
| extend DetailsStr = tostring(AdditionalDetails)
| where isempty(Justification) or strlen(trim(' ', Justification)) < 5 or DetailsStr !has 'Justification'
| extend ActorUPN = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend ActorIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| extend RoleName = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, RoleName, ActorUPN, ActorIP, Justification, DetailsStr

properties.displayName: Essential Eight - Dormant Privileged Account Exceeding 45 Days Inactivity
Essential Eight - Dormant Privileged Account Exceeding 45 Days Inactivity
properties.description:
Identifies enabled Microsoft Entra ID accounts holding privileged directory roles that have not
signed in for 45 days or more. The ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model (November 2023) requires
privileged access to be automatically disabled after 45 days of inactivity at Maturity Level 2
(E8-RAP-ML2-01).
Reference: https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model
properties.query:
let privUsers = IdentityInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AssignedRoles, AccountEnabled) by AccountUPN
| where AccountEnabled == true and array_length(AssignedRoles) > 0
| project AccountUPN = tolower(AccountUPN), AssignedRolesStr = tostring(AssignedRoles);
let activeSignins = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(45d)
| where ResultType == '0'
| summarize LastSignIn = max(TimeGenerated) by AccountUPN = tolower(UserPrincipalName);
privUsers
| join kind=leftanti activeSignins on AccountUPN
| project TimeGenerated = now(), AccountUPN, AssignedRolesStr

properties.description:

under CodeIntegrity directories or removal via CiTool.exe, which disables application control
enforcement. Maps to ASD Essential Eight requirements E8-AC-ML1-01 and E8-AC-ML2-03.
Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/application-security/application-control/app-control-for-business/operations/citool-commands

let auditCmds = DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ('Set-RuleOption', 'Audit Mode', 'Option 3')
    and ProcessCommandLine has_any ('CIPolicy', 'WDAC', 'AppControl', 'CodeIntegrity')
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, DetectionSource = 'AuditModeRuleCommand', Details = ProcessCommandLine;

Essential Eight - Microsoft Office Macro Policy Weakened via Registry
properties.description:
Detects registry modifications weakening Microsoft Office macro security controls, including
enabling macros from the internet (blockcontentexecutionfrominternet = 0), enabling all macros
(vbawarnings = 1 or 2), or adding user-level Trusted Locations or Trusted Publishers.

    or (RegistryValueName =~ 'vbawarnings' and RegistryValueData in ('1', '2'))
